Hands-on with mechanics and electrics? Work at one fixed high-tech automated logistics site, earn €4,225–€4,745 gross incl. 30% shift allowance and enjoy 4 days off after 6 shifts. Important location requirement: To be considered for this position, you must already live and be officially registered in the Netherlands within approximately 35 km of Utrecht. Relocation during or after the recruitment process is not possible for this vacancy. Are you working as a Maintenance Technician, Mechatronics Technician, Automotive Technician, Service Technician, Maintenance Mechanic or in another hands-on technical role? Your current job title is less important than your ability to understand, maintain and repair technical equipment. As a Maintenance Technician, you will join an international maintenance team at one fixed, highly automated logistics site in Utrecht. Together with your colleagues, you help keep approximately 14 kilometres of automated systems running 24/7. Your work is practical and varied. You perform preventive and corrective maintenance and help resolve mechanical and electrical faults. One moment you may be replacing a bearing or repairing a shaft, the next you are checking a motor, sensor, drive or conveyor system. The site uses extensive automation, barcode technology, sensors, electric motors and conveyor systems. You do not need to be a PLC specialist. What matters is that you can work with your hands, understand mechanical systems and have a good basic knowledge of electrics. You work in a shift team of around 6–7 maintenance professionals. Jobs are normally carried out together with one or two colleagues, so you learn from experienced Engineers and Technicians while taking on more responsibility as your knowledge grows. The working language is English; Dutch is not required. You work in a 5-shift schedule:
-
2 morning shifts: 06:00–14:30
-
2 afternoon shifts: 14:00–22:30
-
2 night shifts: 22:00–06:30
-
followed by 4 days off

As a Truck Driver for De Klok Dranken in Helmond, your route is the ultimate Dutch hospitality tour! 🚛 You'll be the VIP who delivers the drinks to the coolest bars, trendiest restaurants, and biggest events in the Netherlands. 🏟️ Not only is it an awesome gig, but you'll also earn a great hourly rate—between €17 and €19—in a long-term role. Ready to drive the good times? Read on.

What we offer
- Hourly wage between €17 and €19 per hour
- Drive in nice and modern trucks
- Travel allowance from €0,23 each kilometer
- Development opportunities
- Starting in the morning, home in the evening
- Guaranteed working hours

Who you are
As a truck driver C, you are customer-friendly and service-oriented. You are not afraid to perform physical work and you enjoy having a chat with customers. You also have the requirements below:

- You possess a C driving license, Code 95, and a driver's card
- You can speak English

What will you do
You arrive at De Klok Dranken in the morning for another varied day. You're looking forward to it! You grab a cup of coffee with your colleagues and check the route planning for the day. That’s a calm start. ☕
The schedule includes restaurants, cinemas, and events—in short: Hospitality in all shapes and sizes. It's busy, but you're not worried! You'll handle everything today, with or without a co-driver, depending on the route. Happy customers. Happy team. Happy you! 😁
Your working days are usually Monday through Friday, and you work in day shifts with times ranging from 6:00 AM – 3:00 PM or 8:30 AM – 6:00 PM. Working on a Saturday may occasionally occur, but this is sporadic. In short… a perfect job in combination with your social life. 📴

Where will you work
De Klok Dranken in Helmond is known for its assortment of beers, wines, and soft drinks. It is a dynamic company where teamwork is paramount. Together, you work towards providing the best service ever

Job description 
Do you get energy from finding the right products at the best conditions? Do you have an eye for detail, do you like working in a structured way, and do you enjoy a dynamic work environment? Then we are looking for you! 
At UNIS Group, as an Operational Module Buyer, you play an important role within our organization. You ensure that the right parts are available at the right time, so that our customers can be helped quickly and optimally. In doing so, you work closely with colleagues, suppliers, and other departments to ensure the purchasing process runs smoothly. 
What are you going to do? 
No day is the same. Your responsibilities include: - The purchasing of industrial electronics and related products. - Searching, comparing, and ordering products from suppliers worldwide. - Maintaining and expanding relationships with existing and new suppliers. - Monitoring delivery times and proactively responding to potential delays. - Processing returns and associated administration. - Identifying bottlenecks within the procurement process and suggesting improvements. - The administrative processing and monitoring of all purchasing activities. 
What do we ask of you? - A structured and precise working method. - Good communication skills and a proactive attitude. - A good command of the Dutch and English languages, both spoken and written. - Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and Outlook. - Experience in a similar role is a plus. - Knowledge of industrial electronics is a plus.
